milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find lantern' is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the fence-post lantern (at spawn-relative [3, 1, 3]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. The fence-post lantern is chosen as the target because it is the most prominent and closest lantern in the scene, clearly visible from near spawn. max_distance=16 is generous (the lantern is only ~4 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the lantern rather than away from it.
